title: Can AI Generate more Comprehensive Test Scenarios? – Review on Automated Driving Systems Test Scenario Generation Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether datasets and generated automated driving scenarios are balanced across multiple geographic regions using a proposed Ethical and Safety Checklist.
Assessing the diversity and representation of demographics, particularly vulnerable road users (VRUs) such as pedestrians and cyclists, in generated traffic scenarios.

Measuring the balance and representation of varying operational conditions, such as day/night lighting, diverse weather conditions, and traffic patterns, utilizing an Operational Design Domain (ODD) coverage score.
